version.changelog: Initial release: 48 commands covering repos, models, datasets, spaces, jobs, endpoints, papers, collections, discussions, buckets, cache, and sync

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (wrapping the official Hugging Face CLI): it only requires the hf binary and HF_TOKEN and the instructions match the advertised capabilities, though the install instructions include executing a remote installer script which you should review before running.

dimensions.detail: The name/description, required binary (hf), and required env var (HF_TOKEN) align with managing Hugging Face Hub resources via the official CLI. Requested capabilities (repos, datasets, jobs, endpoints) match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only CLI operations relevant to the Hub (download/upload, create/delete repos, run jobs, deploy endpoints) and how to authenticate via HF_TOKEN. It does not instruct reading unrelated system files or unrelated credentials. It does include operations that can modify remote resources (create/delete, deploy) which are expected for this skill and require a write-scoped token.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Registry install spec uses the Homebrew formula 'hf' (reasonable). SKILL.md also recommends running a remote installer via 'curl | bash' (and equivalent PowerShell). The installer is hosted under hf.co (Hugging Face domain), but executing remote scripts is higher-risk; prefer the brew installation or review the installer script before executing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only HF_TOKEN is required and declared as the primary credential. That is appropriate for a CLI that interacts with the Hugging Face Hub. The docs correctly explain permission levels (read vs write); users should prefer least privilege (read) when possible.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and is user-invocable. It does not request config paths or modify other skills. Normal autonomous invocation is allowed by default but presents no additional incoherence here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears to do what it says: use it to manage Hugging Face Hub resources via the official 'hf' CLI. Before installing/using it:
- Prefer installing via Homebrew (registry spec) or inspect the remote install script (curl https://hf.co/cli/install.sh) before piping it to a shell.
- Use the least-privilege HF_TOKEN possible: use a Read token for downloads/browsing and only grant Write if you need to create/delete/upload or deploy endpoints.
- Treat HF_TOKEN as a secret: store it securely (not in world-readable files) and avoid exposing it to untrusted processes.
- Be aware that commands shown can delete repos, deploy endpoints, and run cloud jobs if the token has write scope—double-check commands before executing.
- If you run this in a multi-user or CI environment, limit token scope and rotate tokens regularly.
Overall this skill is coherent and matches its purpose; the main operational risk is executing the remote installer script and the usual risks of granting write-scoped tokens.
